1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any
   contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: Separation is where VCS stops and graph begins; the gate forces each clause to answer to its prerequisite. Its four edges span two cells — three prose parents (natural→natural) and one artifact parent (code→natural) — so the criterion is the default cell's gate form; the mixed cell is flagged for the matrix (F1 follow-up).
